# pinyol

> A small C engine for 2D games on the Cirera console (ESP32-S3, 480x320 touch screen) and in the browser: a game is a
> folder of Lua (pinyol@2, a GBA-like virtual console: four backgrounds, 128 sprites, palettes, per-line effects) or of
> JSON data (pinyol@1 adventures), tested headless with scripts, sent to the console over USB.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ipaud/pinyol#readme): what it is, quick start, the examples, the editor, the console
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/AGENTS.md): how a coding agent makes a game here (build, test, the folders)
- [docs/lua.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/lua.md): the whole Lua API, the built-in libraries, the test scripts
- [docs/tutorial.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/tutorial.md): a first game step by step
- [docs/art.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/art.md): the looks (Game Boy, Spectrum, GBA, 16 bits, Neo Geo...) and how to make art for them
- [docs/game-format.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/game-format.md): the data adventures' JSON
- [docs/hardware.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/hardware.md): the console's pins and peripherals
- [docs/measurements.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ipaud/pinyol/main/docs/measurements.md): what things cost on the console

## Play

- [Every example in the browser](https://pinyol.ipaud.dev/)
- [The Library](https://pinyol.ipaud.dev/biblioteca/): games people sent
- [The editor](https://pinyol.ipaud.dev/editor/): games without code
